{{Quote|Captain Quellium works out of the Wideband Temp Agency, a front company for Rebel recruiting located west of town, due south of the Starport.|[[Dathnaeya Loessin]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:CoA" />}}
The '''Wideband Temp Agency''' was a front company for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was based in the city of [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]], on the planet [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].

==History==
{{Quote|I'm just a guest here. You'll need to speak to Captain Quellium if you need something from this office.|[[Trezya Nenei]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:RI">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Rebel Investigation|Talus}}</ref>}}
The Wideband Temp Agency was as a front company for Rebel recruiters on Talus by the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was located in a building in Dearic that served as the office of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Vayde Quellium]].<ref name="SWG:CoA" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Trezya Nenei]], a representative of the anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] movement known as the [[Aggregate Civil Liberties Organization]], visited the office in order to negotiate the integration of the A.C.L.O. in the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="SWG:RI" /> In the meantime, [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] officer [[Dathnaeya Loessin]] sent a spacer to the office to work with Captain Quellium because she wanted to learn more about the ideologies and practices of the Empire and the Rebellion.<ref name="SWG:CoA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Wideband Temp Agency appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CoA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Wideband Temp Agency was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Crisis of Allegiance|Crisis of Allegiance]]" arc with the release of "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 2|Chapter 2: The Talus Incident]]," on [[August 1]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 2: The Talus Incident Publish Notes, August 1st">{{SonyForumsCite|full_url=http://soe.lithium.com/swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=58871|text="Chapter 2: The Talus Incident" Publish Notes, August 1st}}</ref>
